messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 14(3)

Article 14 Obligations of importers of partly completed machinery. 3. Importers shall indicate their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, and the postal address and website, email address or other digital contact at which they can be contacted, on the partly completed machinery or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the partly completed machinery. The contact details shall be in a language easily understood by the person who incorporates the partly completed machinery and by the market surveillance authorities.
